*[Sensory Experiences: Exploring Meaning and the Senses](https://benjamins.com/catalog/celcr.24)* — the volume I co-authored with Danièle Dubois, Caroline Cance, Arthur Paté, and Catherine Guastavino — was featured in Issue #30 of the [ISA Research/Thematic Group 07 "Senses and Society" Newsletter](https://www.isa-sociology.org/uploads/imgen/2440-tg07newsletter-february-2026.pdf), themed this issue around senses and cognition.

The write-up situates the book within a broader discussion of how sensing and cognition are entangled in the production of social reality, alongside work by Karen Cerulo, Tia DeNora, and a review of *Senses, Cognition, and Ritual Experience in the Roman World*.
